tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Explain what Check and Launch is, the guided workflows, and a suggested way to check an app before launch. Call this first.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.description: List the launch checks grouped by category, with each check's id, priority, and whether it is free or in Check and Launch Pro.

tools.name: review_area
tools.description: Get what to look for in one area of the app (project, security, payments, experience, discoverability, trust, operations or launch): for each check, what you can investigate, what you can't see, and how to report it.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain one check in full, at the user's level: what it is, why it matters, what could happen if it's left, how to look into it, how to fix it, how to confirm the fix, and how to report it. Also teaches a learning topic, such as database-security or payments (get_started lists them).

tools.name: fix_steps
tools.description: Give the steps to fix one check, a copy-ready request for the user's AI builder, and how to confirm it worked.

tools.name: verify_steps
tools.description: Give a repeatable test to confirm one check's fix worked, and how to report the result.

tools.name: launch_report
tools.description: Get the structure and rules for writing a launch-readiness report from LAUNCH-CHECK.md for the app's owner.

tools.name: launch_day_order
tools.description: List what to do on launch day, in order.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

evidence.snippet: Look at who can reach the app's data, where its secret keys are, and how sign-in works, using the Data and access and Sign-up, sign-in, and email checks.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "prompt:learn_database_security" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: A short lesson on how AI-built apps protect their data (access rules, public keys and secret keys), using this app as the example.
